plan.name: link each card to /act, and ratify plans together
plan.summary: Each card in the public page's Needs you links to the same card on /act: when the dashboard serves /act, each waiting issue in the page's data carries Waiting.ActURL, /act?issue=owner/repo%23n, and /act served at that link marks its body data-open="owner/repo#n", for an issue the dashboard shows, and opens scrolled to that card, highlighted; the public page keeps its copy buttons and still posts nothing. Each waiting proposal that changes no statement, a plumbing plan, a plan of issues or a rebuild at its lock's hash, is marked Waiting.Together, and a plan of issues also carries Waiting.IssuePlan, with its Summary and Issues, each issue's title in order, so its card describes the plan instead of counting statements. On /act, when two or more of them wait, one Ratify all asks once, listing each one's issue, name and hash, then sends exactly those to a new POST /act/api/ratify as {"ratify":[{"repo","issue","hash"}]}, which, like /act/api/comment, takes only the owner's own page, and which the agent's door doesn't serve. The server checks every line exactly as it checks a single command, refuses the whole batch and posts nothing if any isn't the ratify its issue waits for or names a proposal that changes statements, and then posts each ratify on its own issue as the owner, so a proposal that changes statements still ratifies alone, from its own card. SPEC.md's /act bullet says what it does now; act.go is in the trusted base, so a person merges this.

tests.name: TestAPublicCardLinksToItsCardOnAct
tests.says: On the public page, the card of an issue waiting for ratification links to that issue's card on /act, which opens at it once Cloudflare Access signs the owner in; the public page posts nothing, and a dashboard that doesn't serve /act doesn't link to it.

tests.name: TestOneConfirmationRatifiesEveryPlan
tests.says: On /act, with a plumbing plan and a plan of issues waiting, one confirmation posts /invariant ratify <hash> on each plan's issue with its own hash, as the owner, and on no other issue; a batch with a hash its issue isn't waiting for posts nothing, and the agent's door takes no batch.

tests.name: TestAProposalThatChangesStatementsRatifiesAlone
tests.says: A proposal that changes statements, new or amended, is left out of that batch: only plans and rebuilds that change no statement are marked to ratify together, a batch that names one is refused with nothing posted, and it still ratifies on its own.
